I replied to Pree in a thread on her message in #central-team: the store was **Pine Crossing**.

It comes from her own Jun 9 message in #central-team. The morning receiver said the appointment screen showed only the afternoon shift, and a driver who arrived at 7:10 had his trailer number written on a sticky note. Hollis said he would check the shift template.

I couldn't find a site ID or address for Pine Crossing in #central-team or the shared files. I told her the store name is the only part I can confirm. I used only #central-team (she's a member) and public files.
